entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Thorn-wrapped staff

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hold someone cutting the tree while opening firm ground for refugees. Release the hold if the shared restrictions prevent a needed retreat.

**Encounter and conversation:** Its tree shelters refugees whose presence has drawn woodcutters and hunters into conflict.

**Habitat:** Old woodland; crossroads; hidden court · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Fey 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/dryad.md).

# Weave the Roots

*Roots braid themselves into firm footholds across the treacherous ground.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-root-bridge


**Action:** Maneuver

Choose up to 3 connected difficult-terrain ground squares within 3 squares; they count as normal terrain until its next turn. Requires soil or living vegetation; cannot bridge empty space or bypass occupied squares.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

monsterAbilityTemplates.name: Seizing Limbs
monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Seizing Limbs

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-seizing-limbs


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
